data.label: Focus of Spirit
data.description:
Focuses your target's spiritual energy, granting increased hit points, strength, and dexterity for 1 hour(s) 40.0 mins.
This spell has an unusual stacking mechanic. If a character has Focus, it will block the addition of Maniacal Strength, Mortal Deftness, and Voice of the Berserker spells. ''However'' if the character already has those buffs prior, the addition of Focus on top of those will not overwrite them, rather it will stack and both will apply to the character's statistics. Therefore, if a melee character would like all three buffs, they should click off any pre-existing Focus, then ask the Shaman for them.
Focus of Spirit will always overwrite other Talisman spells however. It also seems to overwrite lower level spells such as Dexterity.

Does not stack with Shield of the Magi and other INT caster HP buffs. Does not stack with Bedlam and other enchanter mat-free runes in that line. Does stack with Resurrection Effects.

data.label: Eye of Zomm

Conjures a magical eye that allows you to scout dangerous areas.
While under the effect of this spell, a new low level NPC is spawned that looks like a spinning eye. After a short delay, the camera switches to follow this eye and the caster can control it with most normal movement commands. The eye has the same faction as the player, and if the player is not under Feign Death, they will gain any aggro which the eye has. Thus, it is useful as a long-range pulling method.

It's possible to summon the eye and hit it with weapons such as the Worker Sledgemallet just to gain a proc effect. It has good swimming speed but cannot jump and may have difficulty getting out of the water.

Can not be cast in Plane of Sky or Kedge Keep.

data.description:
Opens an arcane portal that teleports your entire group to the Skyfire Mountains. This spell no longer has a Kunark dungeon requirement; it can currently be cast from anywhere in the world.

'''Warning: The port in location for this spell is very dangerous.''' If you port in while visible, you will most likely die when alone or porting another. There are swarms of dispelling mobs at the zone in area. However, while invis, this port in location is nearly 100% safe. No mobs see invis and the only threat is the possibility of it breaking early. You can enter the zone invisibly by getting a friendly person to invis prime you. To perform this, join a group, and have that person begin to invis you. Before their cast finishes, begin your cast of Tishan's Relocation. Once their invis hits you, disband or have them disband before you finish the cast. You will port over to skyfire while remaining invis, as finishing casts does not break invisibility. With a primed invis, the port in at skyfire is much safer, and a very useful tool to Wizards.
